metadata.title: Desolate Seascape with Geometric Display Type

retrievalProfile.description: A low-angle, desaturated purple seascape featuring choppy waves under a dark sky, anchored by a centered geometric display title.
triggerTerms: geometric display type on dark sky

recipe.visualDefinition: A somber, atmospheric composition divided by a central horizon line. The lower half consists of high-contrast, textured purple waves captured from a low perspective, while the upper half is a flat, dark violet sky. A bold, white geometric title is centered in the upper third, featuring a small illustrative icon integrated into one of the letters.
coreVisualRelationships: Monochromatic purple palette vs. stark white typography
Low-angle perspective creating a sense of immersion
Central horizontal division of the frame
coreInvariants: Centered geometric typography in the sky region

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The choppy water occupies the bottom 60% of the frame; the sky occupies the top 40%.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The white geometric title centered in the dark sky.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the bright white text, moves down to the horizon line, and then follows the texture of the waves toward the foreground.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The dark, flat sky provides significant negative space to emphasize the typography.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with high value contrast in the water texture; low value contrast in the sky.

letterConstructionRules: Rounded external corners with sharp internal counters
characterSpecificRedesigns: The letter 'O' is replaced or modified to contain a small circular illustrative element (flame icon).
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used for maximum impact against the textured background.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the square, technical, and wide aesthetic of the original lettering.
Provides the necessary geometric structure and rounded-square feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A low-angle photograph of a choppy, dark purple ocean at dusk. The water is full of small, high-contrast waves. The sky is a flat, dark violet. The horizon line is perfectly horizontal and centered.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a single line of bold, white, geometric sans-serif text in the upper third of the image. The text should be centered and have a wide, square appearance.

verificationChecks: Is the color palette strictly monochromatic purple/violet?
Is the typography centered in the sky area?
Does the water have a high-contrast, choppy texture?
Are the outer corners of the letters rounded while maintaining a square footprint?

mustRedesign: The specific flame icon inside the 'O' must be replaced with a generic geometric shape or different icon.
The specific brand name must be changed to user-defined text.
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text is perfectly horizontal.
Check that the purple hue is consistent across sky and water.
Verify that the text is legible against the dark sky background.
Confirm the low-angle perspective of the camera.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a high-texture monochromatic landscape with centered, bold geometric display type in the negative space of the sky.
